_comment: actual-clean.json with ONE injected defect per diff category (a)-(h). Every departure from the clean
mirror is marked `INJECTED (x)` below, and `manifest.json` names the finding each one must produce.
The self-check asserts SET EQUALITY both ways, so a defect that stops being reported fails by name,
and a finding the diff invents fails too.
Three injections cascade on purpose, and the manifest lists every consequence rather than only the
headline: the grey neutral/900 is both a stale value (c) AND two AA failures (g), and a component the
file does not have is both a missing component (f) AND its binding going unbound (a). A cascade the
manifest did not list would fail as an EXTRA — which is the point. The two arms are independent, and
the fixture proves it by requiring both to fire.
Two injections are OMISSIONS and so have no marker to carry — read them against actual-clean.json:
(f) `gadget` is gone from `structure`, and its one binding is gone from `bindings`
(f) `fix/color/text/secondary` is gone from `variables` — the missing-variable path, which is the
highest-consequence finding in the report and the one an omission-shaped defect would leave

fix/color/icon/primary._injected: (d) mode-coverage — the `dark` mode the engine emits is missing

fix/core/palette/neutral/900._injected: (c) value-match, and (g) contrast ×2 — hand-nudged from rgba(26,26,26,1) to a mid grey, which both drifts from the emitted value and drops light-mode text below 4.5:1

fix/size/md/height._injected: (e) scope-type — scopes widened to ALL_SCOPES, so the variable is offered where it should not be. The VALUE is untouched, which is what keeps this a scope finding and not a value one.

fix/opacity/veil._injected: (e) scope-type — wrong resolvedType. Nothing binds this variable and no contract measures it, so the finding cannot be a side effect of another arm.

widget|size=md, state=rest|/|fills._injected: (a) binding-presence — a raw literal where the engine binds fix/color/background/primary

widget|size=md, state=rest|/label|fills._injected: (b) binding-target — bound to the ICON role where the engine binds the TEXT role, the exact confusion the category exists for

widget|size=md, state=rest|/label|textSt._injected: (a) binding-presence — a VARIABLE where the engine binds a text STYLE. A different Figma API, not a wrong value, so it must be reported as a presence failure and never as a target one: `fix/color/text/primary` is not a plausible replacement for `body/md/default`, and a target finding would invite a fix that cannot work.

widget|size=md, state=rest|/caption|font._injected: (a) binding-presence, the DETACHED shape — `/caption textStyle` is gone from this file, but all three of the style's font fields are still here. So the node reads correct on every property and has lost the style LINK. A diff that only looked for a wrong value would call this clean.

widget|size=md, state=hover|/|strokeTopW._injected: (b) binding-target, the per-side DISAGREEMENT — the engine binds one uniform strokeWeight and this member's left/right sides point somewhere else. The `rest` member above keeps all four agreeing, so the same lenience is proven working and failing in one file.
